change.runtime: Keep file loading, runtime lifetime and public callback scheduling in script_engine.cpp.
change.native_api: Move 48 native wrapper method bodies, scene query/component helpers, typed callback invocation and reload migration to script_scene_api.cpp. Keep 21 small methods inline.
change.registration: Move the existing ordered binding definitions and receiver/liveness adapters to script_scene_bindings.cpp.
change.private_headers: Share unchanged host/Impl definitions and userdata declarations. Hidden kin::s types with aliases in scripting_detail give all translation units one identity and compact sol registry keys. Internal C++/sol names change, public Lua type names remain unchanged.
change.dispatch: Explicitly instantiate the existing call_optional template for scene/context/action arguments in the native API unit. No extra sol::object wrapper/allocation per callback. Outlining may remove prior inlining opportunities.
change.guard_state: Keep the unchanged thread-local guard/command definitions with native API execution to retain known static initialization for direct accesses.

clean_build_interpretation: One normal four-worker clean-own-output build/version through hex_demo link, pinned CPUs 0,2,4,6. Dependencies and shader generation prebuilt. Background load changes and the unchanged-task comparison confound the full wall-time ratio. Do not infer a precise whole-project or cumulative speedup. Header/source/configuration rewrites and Ninja-log compaction occur only between completed builds.
paired_lua_rebuild_method: One ABBA block: two observations/version. Compile the original combined source or all three split sources from stable copies, with matching target flags/PCH. The longest binding file uses CPU 2 in both versions; after uses CPU 0 for native API and 6 for runtime. An unchanged core/json.cpp control uses CPU 4. Four worker limit and affinity 0,2,4,6. Divert linker dependency files and Ninja logs per sample. Link explicit replacement objects into cached hex_demo; its report must match. Other engine/game/dependency objects and shaders are prebuilt. Explicit objects may force archive members an ordinary game link could omit; this measures the scene compilation set and link, not a whole clean project or ordinary scheduling.
cpu_and_memory_tradeoff: The split exposes parallel work and smaller edit scopes. It can increase aggregate compiler CPU, object/COMDAT overhead, and memory when several units run concurrently. GNU time max-child RSS is not total simultaneous memory. Report both CPU and wall time; do not extrapolate the parallel gain to single-worker or clean whole-project builds.
edit_method: Three real trailing-comment edits before and for final runtime, plus one final observation each for native API and registration, each through canonical hex_demo link with four workers pinned 0,2,4,6. Exact planned/actual C++ output sets asserted. Restore bytes and nanosecond timestamps after each sample. Before the combined source contained all three roles. After each implementation-only edit compiles one source; shared private header edits still compile three.

runtime_key_regression.finding: The initial shared kin::scripting_detail namespace made sol registry keys longer than the bundled Lua 40-byte short-string limit; sol2 removes anonymous-namespace text from the original names. Both compilers showed about 5% slower scene-bridge probes. Hidden visibility alone reduced but did not remove the Clang regression.
runtime_key_regression.fix: Keep shared C++ identity in compact hidden kin::s types and aliases for readable internal use. All ten primary/reference metatable keys are checked at most 40 bytes in the scripting regression test. Callback bodies and safety checks remain unchanged.

prototype_notes: The first runtime compile identified the retained take_scene() code needing the direct scene_preload2d.hpp include; it was restored. Failed log pilot-script_engine.log is retained.
The initial binding compile identified its direct workflows2d.hpp declaration include; it was added. Failed log pilot-fixed-script_scene_bindings.log is retained.

Successful initial isolated compiles were runtime 5.13s, native API 9.66s and registration 18.33s, versus 31.18s before. They preceded moving the unchanged TLS provider definitions into the native API unit. The later complete builds/edit samples measure the final source bytes.
limits: No Windows/MSVC or full native desktop/3D/GPU runtime validation. Optional feature checks are syntax/template compilation only.
Private C++ wrapper identities/sol registry keys change to a shared named namespace. Public Lua reports and userdata layouts/traits match; this is not cross-platform ABI certification.

The first clean build source/configuration temporarily return to base under a guard; split files are restored before the after build and final checks. No agent-owned validation compilers overlap timing; host activity is uncontrolled.

steps: Prepare normal Clang/GCC build configurations and cached targets at base_commit. Save original script_engine.cpp and engine/CMakeLists.txt to before-<basename>. Adjust paths/TMPDIR/CPU affinity.

Build the original Clang runtime-before probe with scene_split_runtime.py before. Run scene_split_compile.py before script_engine and scene_split_edit.py before (older output names before-edits.json; current script adds the source name).

Run scene_split_transform.py, configure Clang with normal flags and build scene_split_validate.py clang. Keep direct includes for preloaded scenes and workflows; the final transformation includes both.

Run scene_split_layout.py and scene_split_full.py with all worktree compilers stopped. The latter restores the original combined source/CMake for the first full build, then restores the split before the second.

The original scene_split_post.py measurements are retained as the long-namespace prototype. The final scene_split_transform.py also applies scene_split_compact.py. Run scene_split_final_measure.py for final mechanical/regeneration/layout checks, both compiler validations/runtime probes, final paired builds/edit scopes, optional checks and final whole build. Run scene_split_key_negative.py once the final tests are built, using retained long-name prototype objects; it must fail the length assertion.

Run scene_split_final.py to refresh canonical objects after comment edits, verify smoke tests/API reports/no-change builds, then scene_split_record.py. No header/source/configuration/Ninja-log edits while compilers are active.
